title: Smoke Test: Alpha vs Beta
hook: One of these tools writes a full report in under a minute.

rounds.title: Speed
rounds.aPoint: Alpha drafts a report in forty seconds flat.
rounds.bPoint: Beta takes about two minutes to finish.

rounds.title: Quality
rounds.aPoint: Alpha writes clear, well structured sections.
rounds.bPoint: Beta reads a little generic without editing.

battle.verdict: Alpha wins overall for speed and clarity. Beta is still solid for short simple notes.

narration.text: One of these two writing tools finishes a full report in under a minute.
Round one is speed. Alpha drafts a complete report in about forty seconds, while Beta needs closer to two minutes to get there.
Round two is quality. Alpha writes clear and well structured sections, but Beta can read a little generic until you edit it yourself.
So Alpha wins this one for speed and clarity. Beta is still solid for short simple notes. Which would you pick?
